Their diffraction scores are essentially indistinguishable, so the ordering is not uniquely resolved; however, that discrete ambiguity is covered rather than hidden by mixed occupancy, with selected.cif chemically favored by its short Nb-O bond. Although no independent comparable-Rwp report is available, the trace provides enough direct whole-pattern evidence, and no materially different structure is presently likely to improve the candidate set.
